title: AgentSec Ingested Static Posture Report
description: The normalised shape `posture.adapter.load_posture_report` produces from AgentShield's native JSON or from SARIF, before correlation against the project's discovered surfaces. Input only: nothing here is a PurpleVerdict, an axis, or a grade a `secure` can be derived from (issue #25, ADR 0002). Deliberately does not carry matched source text — only rule id, severity, category and file path survive from whatever the scanner emitted.

source_tool.description: Lowercased tool name, e.g. 'agentshield' or the SARIF driver's own name.

file.description: Project-relative path, refused by project.resolver.safe_child if it resolves outside the project root.
